observable_work_alignment.statement: Every staged operation renders queued/running(phase)/terminal exactly as emitted; determinate progress appears only when the payload carries completed+total with total>0 (copy apply/rollback do); terminal states hold visibly for five seconds before the strip clears. No second progress owner exists in the concept.
